query: INSERT INTO workspace_user_invite(id, workspace_id, email, token_hash, token_expiry, invite_attempts, invited_by, created) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 0, $6, $7) ON CONFLICT (workspace_id, email) DO UPDATE SET token_hash = EXCLUDED.token_hash, token_expiry = EXCLUDED.token_expiry, invite_attempts = 0, invited_by = EXCLUDED.invited_by, created = EXCLUDED.created RETURNING id AS "id: Uuid";
